clues.text: At creation, God called the light day, and He gave this the name night.
When Moses stretched his hand toward heaven, it covered all the land of Egypt for three days.
While Jesus hung on the cross, it came over all the land from the sixth hour to the ninth.
At Sinai the people stood far off while Moses drew near to the thick cover of this where God was.
In Jesus' wedding feast story, the guest without wedding clothes was bound and thrown into its outer part.
John wrote that the Light shines in it, and it has not overcome the Light.
Isaiah foretold that the people walking in this would see a great light dawn on them.
